scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @researchchain/web lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api scripts && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api scripts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @researchchain/web typecheck && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/src
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api scripts
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/export-api.py && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/api.ts && prettier --write packages/contracts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
